Seamless 360 degree cylindrical panorama strip, a skybox backdrop for a stylised video game with the stylised realism of a modern Nintendo golf game: believable light and atmosphere, bold saturated colour, slightly painterly. A perfectly straight level horizon line runs across the whole image at one fifth of the height from the bottom edge. Below the horizon only a misty pale green valley floor. Above it a soft spring morning: pale blue sky warming to pink-peach near the horizon, a gentle sun in the left third about one third of the way up, a few soft white clouds. All the way round the horizon run misty layered blue-green mountains, ridge behind ridge fading into pale haze like an ink landscape painting, the nearest slopes dusted pink with cherry blossom, none taller than one fifth of the image height. No single conical mountain. No foreground objects, no people, no animals, no text, no logos, no real landmarks, no lens flare streaks, no vignette, no frame. The left edge and the right edge match exactly so the strip wraps around seamlessly.
